units.source_text: 我去的时候是将要掌灯的傍晚，一向守约的先生已经不在家了。

en.t: When I went, it was evening, just about the time lamps would be lit, and Sensei, who was always punctual, was already no longer at home.

units.source_text: “他怕去晚了，刚刚出门。”

en.t: "He was afraid of being late, so he just went out."

units.source_text: 夫人说着，把我请进了先生的书房。

en.t: His wife said this and invited me into Sensei's study.

units.source_text: 书房除了书桌、椅子之外，还有书柜，灯光透过书柜的玻璃照着一排排漂亮的书脊。

en.t: Besides a desk and chair, the study had bookcases, and the lamplight shone through their glass doors onto row after row of handsome book spines.

units.source_text: 夫人让我坐在火盆前铺着的坐垫上，说：“请在这儿看看书吧。”

en.t: His wife had me sit on the cushion laid before the brazier and said, "Please read a book here for a while."

units.source_text: 说完就出去了。

en.t: After saying this, she went out.

units.source_text: 我就像是等候主人回家的客人一样，拘谨地坐在那里抽着烟。

en.t: Like a guest waiting for the master of the house to return, I sat there stiffly smoking.

units.source_text: 这时，听见夫人在茶室对女佣说话的声音。

en.t: Then I heard his wife speaking to the maid in the tea room.

units.source_text: 书房在茶室的檐廊尽头拐角处，从房屋的位置来看，这个偏远的角落比客厅要安静得多。

en.t: The study was at the corner at the end of the veranda by the tea room, and from the layout of the house, this remote corner was much quieter than the parlor.

units.source_text: 夫人对女佣说完话之后，便没有了声音。

en.t: After his wife finished speaking to the maid, there was no more sound.

units.source_text: 我心里惦记着小偷，屏气凝神地留意着周围的动静。

en.t: With the thief on my mind, I held my breath and listened intently to the movements around me.

units.source_text: 约莫过了半个小时，夫人又到书房门口探头看了看。

en.t: After about half an hour, his wife again came to the doorway of the study and peered in.

units.source_text: 她“哎呀”了一声，用有些惊讶的眼神望着我。

en.t: She said, "Oh," and looked at me with slightly surprised eyes.

units.source_text: 大概是看我像个客人似的正襟危坐的样子，觉得很好笑吧。

en.t: Perhaps she found it funny to see me sitting so formally, like a visitor.

units.source_text: “你不用太拘束。”

en.t: "You do not need to be so stiff."

units.source_text: “不拘束。”

en.t: "I am not being stiff."

units.source_text: “觉得无聊吧？”

en.t: "You must be bored, aren't you?"

units.source_text: “不无聊，心里总惦记小偷会不会来，也就不觉得了。”

en.t: "I am not bored; I keep wondering whether the thief might come, so I do not really feel bored."

units.source_text: 夫人端着红茶，笑吟吟地站在门口。

en.t: His wife stood in the doorway holding black tea, smiling.

units.source_text: “这屋子太偏，不适合看家。”我说。

en.t: "This room is too far off in a corner; it is not suited for keeping watch over the house," I said.
